schema.text: Which economic status do you think best describes your household?

options.text: We struggle to cover basic needs
We can cover basic needs comfortably and have little money left over
We can afford most things we want with occasional extra expenses
We are financially very comfortable and can easily afford extra expenses

schema.help: We ask this to compare how household circumstances may affect everyday mobility and access to services. Results are reported as grouped totals, not individual answers.

en.#Which economic status do you think best: Which economic status do you think best describes your household?
en.#We struggle to cover basic needs: We struggle to cover basic needs
en.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: We can cover basic needs comfortably and have little money left over
en.#We can afford most things we want with: We can afford most things we want with occasional extra expenses
en.#We are financially very comfortable and: We are financially very comfortable and can easily afford extra expenses
en.#We ask this to compare how household ci: We ask this to compare how household circumstances may affect everyday mobility and access to services. Results are reported as grouped totals, not individual answers.

it.#Which economic status do you think best: Quale situazione economica descrive meglio il tuo nucleo familiare?
it.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Abbiamo difficoltà a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We can cover basic needs: Riusciamo a coprire le necessità di base
it.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Riusciamo a coprire comodamente le necessità di base e ci rimane una piccola somma
it.#We can afford most things we want with: Possiamo permetterci la maggior parte delle cose che desideriamo e occasionalmente alcune spese extra
it.#We are financially very comfortable and: Siamo in una situazione economica molto agiata e possiamo permetterci facilmente spese extra
it.#We ask this to compare how household ci: Questa risposta ci aiuta a confrontare come le condizioni economiche del nucleo possono influire sugli spostamenti quotidiani e sull’accesso ai servizi. Presentiamo i risultati in forma aggregata, non come risposte individuali.

fr.#Which economic status do you think best: Quelle situation économique décrit le mieux votre foyer, selon vous ?
fr.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nous avons du mal à couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We can cover basic needs: Nous pouvons couvrir nos besoins essentiels
fr.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Nous couvrons facilement nos besoins essentiels, mais il nous reste peu d’argent
fr.#We can afford most things we want with: Nous pouvons nous permettre la plupart des choses que nous souhaitons, avec quelques dépenses supplémentaires occasionnelles
fr.#We are financially very comfortable and: Nous sommes très à l’aise financièrement et pouvons facilement faire face à des dépenses supplémentaires
fr.#We ask this to compare how household ci: Cette réponse nous aide à comparer la façon dont la situation du foyer peut influer sur les déplacements quotidiens et l’accès aux services. Les résultats sont présentés sous forme agrégée, pas comme des réponses individuelles.

de.#Which economic status do you think best: Welche wirtschaftliche Situation beschreibt Ihren Haushalt Ihrer Meinung nach am besten?
de.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Wir haben Schwierigkeiten, unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse zu bezahlen
de.#We can cover basic needs: Wir können unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse bezahlen
de.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Wir können unsere grundlegenden Bedürfnisse gut bezahlen, aber es bleibt nur wenig Geld übrig
de.#We can afford most things we want with: Wir können uns die meisten Dinge leisten, die wir möchten, und gelegentliche zusätzliche Ausgaben tragen
de.#We are financially very comfortable and: Wir sind finanziell sehr gut aufgestellt und können zusätzliche Ausgaben problemlos tragen
de.#We ask this to compare how household ci: Diese Antwort hilft uns zu vergleichen, wie die Situation eines Haushalts alltägliche Wege und den Zugang zu Dienstleistungen beeinflussen kann. Ergebnisse werden zusammengefasst und nicht als einzelne Antworten dargestellt.

tr.#Which economic status do you think best: Sizce hanenizin ekonomik durumunu aşağıdakilerden hangisi en iyi tanımlar?
tr.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Temel ihtiyaçlarımızı rahatça karşılayabiliyoruz, ancak geriye çok az para kalıyor
tr.#We can afford most things we want with: İstediğimiz çoğu şeyi karşılayabiliyoruz ve ara sıra ek harcamalar yapabiliyoruz
tr.#We are financially very comfortable and: Maddi açıdan çok rahatız ve ek harcamaları kolayca karşılayabiliyoruz
tr.#We ask this to compare how household ci: Bu yanıt, hane koşullarının günlük ulaşımı ve hizmetlere erişimi nasıl etkileyebileceğini karşılaştırmamıza yardımcı olur. Sonuçlar bireysel yanıtlar olarak değil, toplu olarak sunulur.

fa.#Which economic status do you think best: به نظر شما کدام گزینه وضعیت اقتصادی خانوارتان را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟
fa.#We struggle to cover basic needs: برای تأمین نیازهای اولیه مشکل داریم
fa.#We can cover basic needs: می‌توانیم نیازهای اولیه را تأمین کنیم
fa.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: می‌توانیم نیازهای اولیه را به‌راحتی تأمین کنیم، اما پول کمی باقی می‌ماند
fa.#We can afford most things we want with: می‌توانیم بیشتر چیزهایی را که می‌خواهیم تهیه کنیم و گاهی هزینه‌های اضافی هم داشته باشیم
fa.#We are financially very comfortable and: از نظر مالی بسیار راحت هستیم و می‌توانیم هزینه‌های اضافی را به‌راحتی پرداخت کنیم
fa.#We ask this to compare how household ci: این پاسخ به ما کمک می‌کند مقایسه کنیم شرایط خانوار چگونه ممکن است بر رفت‌وآمد روزانه و دسترسی به خدمات اثر بگذارد. نتایج به‌صورت تجمیعی ارائه می‌شوند، نه به‌صورت پاسخ‌های فردی.

hu.#Which economic status do you think best: Ön szerint melyik állítás írja le legjobban a háztartása anyagi helyzetét?
hu.#We struggle to cover basic needs: Nehézséget okoz az alapvető szükségletek fedezése
hu.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: Az alapvető szükségleteket kényelmesen fedezzük, de kevés pénz marad
hu.#We can afford most things we want with: A legtöbb dolgot megengedhetjük magunknak, és időnként extra kiadásokat is vállalhatunk
hu.#We are financially very comfortable and: Anyagilag nagyon kényelmes helyzetben vagyunk, és az extra kiadásokat is könnyen fedezzük
hu.#We ask this to compare how household ci: Ez a válasz segít összehasonlítani, hogyan befolyásolhatják a háztartás körülményei a mindennapi közlekedést és a szolgáltatások elérését. Az eredményeket összesítve, nem egyéni válaszként mutatjuk be.

ar.#Which economic status do you think best: أي وصف يعبر بشكل أفضل عن الوضع الاقتصادي لأسرتك من وجهة نظرك؟
ar.#We struggle to cover basic needs: نواجه صعوبة في تغطية الاحتياجات الأساسية
ar.#We can cover basic needs comfortably an: يمكننا تغطية الاحتياجات الأساسية بسهولة، لكن لا يتبقى لدينا إلا القليل من المال
ar.#We can afford most things we want with: يمكننا تحمل تكلفة معظم الأشياء التي نريدها وبعض المصروفات الإضافية أحيانًا
ar.#We are financially very comfortable and: وضعنا المالي مريح جدًا ويمكننا تحمل المصروفات الإضافية بسهولة
ar.#We ask this to compare how household ci: تساعدنا هذه الإجابة على مقارنة كيف يمكن لظروف الأسرة أن تؤثر في التنقل اليومي والوصول إلى الخدمات. نعرض النتائج بشكل مجمّع، وليس كإجابات فردية.
